title: Probe native Easy Apply (batch pre-filter)
description: Pre-filter a list of LinkedIn job ids for a REAL native Easy Apply before opening any of them. Fetch each /jobs/view/<id>/ page (paced 700ms, same session, one pass) and test for a rendered `<button aria-label="Easy Apply to this job">`. The offsite variant only exists as an escaped JS config string, never as a button. Validated 2026-11-21 with two negative controls (4485224480, 4490444040 -> NO) and 28 true positives. Use BEFORE driving applications so Lever/Workable postings are dropped instead of costing 4-6 tool calls each.
